dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Want to give this a try? It's a little something I call "horizontal composition." What do you think? These lines really stretch out, don't they!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: ...Or maybe not, haha... It does feel a bit too peaceful. Hmm, what about this one with the clear framing? The contrast between light and dark gives it a strong sense of dynamism!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: I see, of course! It feels too oppressive... Right, right, next! Look at this spiral line! Doesn't it give the whole thing an air of focus?!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Ah! Yes, how could I forget? It's too complicated to color! I'm such a fool!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Ahem, but don't you worry, I'll head right back and start racking my brains! I'm the best assistant there is, so I'll definitely come up with a satisfactory plan!
